chapterInfo.content:
17
Mmoa no kum
1Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: 2Kasa kyerɛ Aaron ne ne mma ne Israelfoɔ nyinaa, na ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Yei ne asɛm a AWURADE ahyɛ ho mmara sɛ: 3Obiara a ɔwɔ Israel fie a ɔkum nantwie anaa odwanten anaa abirekyie nsraban no mu anaasɛ ɔku no nsraban no akyire, 4#Yes 66.3 na ɔmfa mma ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano mmɛyɛ ayɛyɛdeɛ mma AWURADE wɔ tenabea anim no, wɔbɛbu mogya agu ne so, waka mogya agu, na wɔbɛtwa saa onipa no afiri ne man mu atwene, 5na ama Israelfoɔ de wɔn afɔdeɛ a wɔkum wɔ ɛserɛ soɔ no abrɛ asɔfoɔ no ama wɔde abrɛ AWURADE wɔ ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano, na wɔakum abɔ AWURADE asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ. 6Na ɔsɔfoɔ no mfa mogya no mpete AWURADE afɔrebukyia no so, ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano, na ɔnhye sradeɛ no na ɛnyi hwa hwanhwam mma AWURADE.
7 # Deut 32.17 Na wɔnnkum wɔn afɔrebɔdeɛ mmma mpapo abosom a wɔdi wɔn akyiri adwamammɔ soɔ no bio. Na ɛnyɛ daa ahyɛdeɛ mma wɔn, wɔn awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu. 8Na wɔn deɛ, ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Obiara a ɔfiri Israel fie anaa ahɔhoɔ a wɔabɛsoɛ wɔn mu no mu a ɔbɛbɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ anaa okum afɔdeɛ bie, 9#Deut 12.14 na wamfa amma ahyiaeɛ ntomadan ano ammɛbɔ amma AWURADE no, wɔbɛtwa no afiri ne man mu atwene.
10 # Lew 3.17 Na obiara a ɔfiri Israel fie anaa ahɔhoɔ a wɔabɛsoɛ wɔn mu no mu a ɔdi mogya biara no, mɛma m’ani asa saa ɔkra a ɔdi mogya no, na matwa no afiri ne man mu atwene. 11#Heb 9.22 Ɛfiri sɛ ɔhonam biara nkwa wɔ mogya no mu, na mede ama mo, afɔrebukyia no so sɛ wɔmfa mpata mma mo ho; na mogya na wɔde pata ma ɔkra. 12Ɛno nti na mese Israelfoɔ sɛ: Mo mu biara nnni mogya, na ɔhɔhoɔ a wabɛsoɛ mo mu no nso nnni mogya. 13Na obiara a ɔfiri Israel mma ne ahɔhoɔ a wɔabɛsoɛ mo mu no a wɔyɛ ha kum aboa anaa anomaa a wɔdie no, wɔnhwie ne mogya ngu na wɔmfa dɔteɛ nkata so. 14#Gye 9.4 Na ɔhonam nyinaa deɛ, ne mogya ne ne nkwa, enti na mese Israelfoɔ sɛ: Monnni nam biara mogya, ɛfiri sɛ honam nyinaa nkwa ne ne mogya; obiara a ɔdie no, wɔbɛtwa no atwene.
15 # Lew 11.40 Na obiara a ɔdi deɛ wawuo anaasɛ deɛ wɔatete no, kuromani oo, ɔhɔhoɔ oo, ɔnsi ne ntadeɛ na ɔmfa nsuo nnware, na ne ho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ ansa na ne ho ate; 16na sɛ wansi ne ntadeɛ na wannware ne ho a, ɛnneɛ ɔnsoa ne mmusuo.

Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Kasa kyerɛ Aaron ne ne mma ne Israelfoɔ nyinaa, na ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Yei ne asɛm a AWURADE ahyɛ ho mmara sɛ: Obiara a ɔwɔ Israel fie a ɔkum nantwie anaa odwanten anaa abirekyie nsraban no mu anaasɛ ɔku no nsraban no akyire, na ɔmfa mma ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano mmɛyɛ ayɛyɛdeɛ mma AWURADE wɔ tenabea anim no, wɔbɛbu mogya agu ne so, waka mogya agu, na wɔbɛtwa saa onipa no afiri ne man mu atwene, na ama Israelfoɔ de wɔn afɔdeɛ a wɔkum wɔ ɛserɛ soɔ no abrɛ asɔfoɔ no ama wɔde abrɛ AWURADE wɔ ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano, na wɔakum abɔ AWURADE asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ. Na ɔsɔfoɔ no mfa mogya no mpete AWURADE afɔrebukyia no so, ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano, na ɔnhye sradeɛ no na ɛnyi hwa hwanhwam mma AWURADE.
Na wɔnnkum wɔn afɔrebɔdeɛ mmma mpapo abosom a wɔdi wɔn akyiri adwamammɔ soɔ no bio. Na ɛnyɛ daa ahyɛdeɛ mma wɔn, wɔn awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu. Na wɔn deɛ, ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Obiara a ɔfiri Israel fie anaa ahɔhoɔ a wɔabɛsoɛ wɔn mu no mu a ɔbɛbɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ anaa okum afɔdeɛ bie, na wamfa amma ahyiaeɛ ntomadan ano ammɛbɔ amma AWURADE no, wɔbɛtwa no afiri ne man mu atwene.
Na obiara a ɔfiri Israel fie anaa ahɔhoɔ a wɔabɛsoɛ wɔn mu no mu a ɔdi mogya biara no, mɛma m’ani asa saa ɔkra a ɔdi mogya no, na matwa no afiri ne man mu atwene. Ɛfiri sɛ ɔhonam biara nkwa wɔ mogya no mu, na mede ama mo, afɔrebukyia no so sɛ wɔmfa mpata mma mo ho; na mogya na wɔde pata ma ɔkra. Ɛno nti na mese Israelfoɔ sɛ: Mo mu biara nnni mogya, na ɔhɔhoɔ a wabɛsoɛ mo mu no nso nnni mogya. Na obiara a ɔfiri Israel mma ne ahɔhoɔ a wɔabɛsoɛ mo mu no a wɔyɛ ha kum aboa anaa anomaa a wɔdie no, wɔnhwie ne mogya ngu na wɔmfa dɔteɛ nkata so. Na ɔhonam nyinaa deɛ, ne mogya ne ne nkwa, enti na mese Israelfoɔ sɛ: Monnni nam biara mogya, ɛfiri sɛ honam nyinaa nkwa ne ne mogya; obiara a ɔdie no, wɔbɛtwa no atwene.
Na obiara a ɔdi deɛ wawuo anaasɛ deɛ wɔatete no, kuromani oo, ɔhɔhoɔ oo, ɔnsi ne ntadeɛ na ɔmfa nsuo nnware, na ne ho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ ansa na ne ho ate; na sɛ wansi ne ntadeɛ na wannware ne ho a, ɛnneɛ ɔnsoa ne mmusuo.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
